From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@lumina.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Joint delivery calendar & decision checkpoints — Lumina discovery

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed joint plan so we have aligned next steps and can share this with your procurement/stakeholder group. I kept this high level so it’s easy to drop into your tracker.

Key pain & goal (as you described):
- Pain: Low-quality inferences on long customer transcripts (slow, high cost on current infra).
- Goal: Deploy an inference stack that reduces 95th-percentile latency under 400ms for typical queries and reduces cost-per-response by ~40% for production workload.

Immediate technical constraints we captured:
- HIPAA-proximate data; security review required by your CISO (Leah) — expected 3-week turnaround.
- On-prem data connectors (SFTP + internal API) needed for initial ingestion — engineering lead is on your side (you mentioned Rahul).
- Peak concurrency: ~120 TPS during business hours, burst to 250 TPS.

Proposed mutual delivery calendar (milestone / owner / target date):
1) Pilot kickoff (prep & infra provisioning) / Lumina + Redwood (Marissa) / target: 2025-07-28
2) Security questionnaire + evidence exchange / Lumina (Leah) & Redwood (Ben) / target: 2025-08-15
3) Integration sprint (connectors + initial dataset) / Lumina Eng & Redwood SE (Ben) / target: 2025-08-29
4) Pilot run (2-week evaluation, performance & cost metrics) / Lumina PM & Redwood (Monica) / target: 2025-09-12
5) Decision checkpoint (go/no-go to production; procurement sign-off) / Lumina execs + Redwood Head of Sales / target: 2025-09-19

Decision process we discussed:
- Technical sign-off from your Engineering and Security teams (must pass security evidence + runbook review).
- Procurement review (T&Cs + pricing) after successful pilot metrics.
- Executive sponsor final approval (you indicated CEO-level buy-in will be a quick yes if pilot hits targets).

Immediate asks / next actions:
- Samir: please confirm Rahul (engineering lead) and Leah (security) are okay with the proposed dates, and share any blackout windows we should avoid.
- Leah: Ben will send the SOC2 summary + preliminary network diagrams by Monday.
- Ben/SE: We’ll share a short runbook for the integration with connector templates (attachment: redwood_se_runbook_v1.pdf).

I’ll update this as a living Mutual Plan and send a version with milestone owners pinned in your tracker once we get the confirmations above.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — super helpful and clear. A couple of quick notes from our side:

1) Security review: Leah confirms she can start the evidence review next Monday (2025-07-21). She flagged that our CISO will want to see data residency controls in addition to SOC2 artifacts — can Ben include a short note on where logs/keys will be stored?

2) Rahul (engineering) is on vacation 2025-07-24 to 2025-08-03. Can we push the integration sprint to start 2025-08-05 instead of 2025-07-29? That would shift the pilot window by one week.

3) Procurement: our procurement lead needs an estimated committed monthly QPS and an initial not-to-exceed cost estimate to build in the SOW. Not final pricing, just a working figure for the procurement calendar.

If those tweaks look reasonable, we can confirm and I’ll circulate the plan internally.

—Samir
